verification_report.summary: The proof is correct. The GAGA/flag-ideal argument identifies the rational PL lattices on a common algebraic model; equality of analytic and algebraic nefness on the smooth projective central-fibre components identifies the relative-nef model cones. The two inclusions between the full cones then follow from the exact MP decreasing-net definition, BJ decreasing closure and ample-class regularization, with generic finiteness checked at the trivial valuation. DXZ Theorem 3.14 applies to the full non-Archimedean psh cone, not merely its finite-energy subspace. All cited results and their contextual definitions match the uses made in the proof.
